verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Supabase has an OpenAPI spec (supabase-probe-3) and auto-generated type-safe APIs (supabase-docs-27, supabase-docs-28), but nothing describes an interactive API reference page with runnable/executable examples that an AI-native user could explore. Missing for 10: any documentation or screenshot of an interactive docs UI, evidence of 'try it' or runnable code snippets, and confirmation this reference is agent/AI accessible.
